name: How long does kitchen painting usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does kitchen painting usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of kitchen painting depends on the size of your kitchen, the number of cabinets, and the complexity of the project. Typically, a standard kitchen cabinet painting job can take anywhere from 3 to 7 days from start to finish. This includes time for prep work like cleaning and sanding, applying primer, multiple coats of paint, and adequate drying time between each layer. We aim to minimize disruption while ensuring a high-quality, lasting finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen painting projects typically take 3 to 7 days, depending on kitchen size and complexity. This timeframe accounts for preparation, multiple paint coats, and necessary drying times.
